milestones.title: Go setup and your first programs
milestones.goal: Run, check and read Go code before writing anything real.
milestones.gate: You can run Go, read the hotel flow’s supplier-code file, and explain what each part of it does.

milestones.title: Our own shipment data model
milestones.goal: Decide what “a shipping option” means in our words, not Swiftpost’s or Cargolink’s.
milestones.gate: The unified shipment models exist in Go, compile, and a Swiftpost and an Cargolink example both fit them.

milestones.title: The supplier contract
milestones.goal: One Go interface every shipping carrier implements.
milestones.gate: The ShipmentProvider interface compiles, and a fake supplier implements it and returns test data.

milestones.title: Swiftpost client and login
milestones.goal: Call Swiftpost Express safely: log in, keep the token fresh, time out, handle errors.
milestones.gate: A login against Swiftpost (or its fake, until Q1 is answered) works, and the token is reused until shortly before it expires.

milestones.title: Search and normalizer
milestones.goal: Turn Swiftpost’s ID-linked lookup tables into our flat shipping options.
milestones.gate: A Swiftpost search response comes back as unified options, with packaging and rate rules joined in.

milestones.title: Preview, extras and hold
milestones.goal: Confirm the price, offer insurance, signature and packaging, then reserve with recipient and tax details.
milestones.gate: Preview → hold works, including a changed price, an expired preview, and a hold with tax details.

topics.title: go run, build, vet, test, gofmt, and go.mod

if with an init statement, for as the only loop, switch without fall-through
Multiple return values, variadic functions, functions as values
fmt verbs (%v %+v %T %q) for printing and debugging

Named types, and const + iota in place of enums
Zero values; "missing" vs "empty"; pointers for optional fields
time.Time, Duration, layouts (02/01/2006 = Swiftpost's dd/MM/yyyy), time zones
